response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval

assumptions.assumption: Scans with a zero spanmin are excluded to avoid division by zero; rows with NULL gbsize or spanmin are ignored.
The average is the mean of per-scan ratios (gbsize/spanmin), not total gbsize divided by total spanmin.
Sites with a NULL riskeval form their own group (shown as NULL).
